title: Tales 003 - The Lost Horse
style: japanese folk storytelling ballad, shamisen, shakuhachi flute, koto, soft taiko, warm clear male vocal, gentle and wise, crisp diction, 92 bpm, very short song, vocals start immediately

lines: An old farmer's only horse ran away one day
What bad luck, the neighbors said, but maybe, he would say
Days later the horse came home and brought a wild stallion
What good luck, the neighbors cried, and maybe, said the old man
His son tried to ride the wild horse, he fell and broke his leg
What bad luck, they said again, and maybe, he said
Then soldiers came and took the young men off to war
Every young man but the one with the broken leg
Who knows what today will turn into
